response.sql: WITH st AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS a FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), base AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS b FROM telescopes) SELECT AVG(st.a) AS mean_avg_above_baseline, AVG(st.a - base.b) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM st CROSS JOIN base WHERE st.a > base.b
